name: Keymaster
type_description: Gate-to-trigger / trigger-to-gate utility with comparator gate conversion
bom_parts_summary: CD40106, TL072 op-amps, 1N4148 diodes, LEDs, resistors, caps, pots, jacks
components_evidence: BOM lists part values (CD40106, TL072, 1N4148, resistors, caps, pots, jacks) but states no package/mounting type (no 0805/SOIC/DIP/TO-92/THT/SMD marking) for any part.
notes: Can be paired with the Gatekeeper module for gate patterns. Page warns to test build before plugging into a case. No HP or licence stated on page.
